title: Whole Grain Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Poultry and Vegetables

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with a tomato‑based sauce, pieces of poultry and added vegetables is a balanced dish that combines slow‑release carbs, protein and vitamins. The sauce is made from ripe tomatoes, aromatic herbs and a touch of olive oil.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta retains the bran and germ, making it more nutritious than regular white pasta.
Tomatoes used in the sauce are rich in lycopene, an antioxidant that supports heart health.
Poultry provides an easy‑to‑digest source of protein and vitamin B6.
Vegetables such as carrots, broccoli and bell pepper add fiber, vitamin C and minerals.
The dish is often served in restaurants as part of a healthy menu suitable for active people.

items.title: Sustained Energy
items.content: Whole grain pasta releases glucose slowly, helping maintain stable energy levels.

items.title: Rich Protein Source
items.content: Poultry supplies essential amino acids needed for muscle repair and growth.

items.title: Antioxidant Protection
items.content: Lycopene from tomatoes helps protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune Support
items.content: Vitamin C from the vegetables boosts immune function.

items.title: Digestive Fiber
items.content: The bran in whole grain pasta and the added vegetables promote healthy digestion.

items.title: Wheat Allergy
items.content: People with celiac disease or gluten intolerance should choose a gluten‑free pasta alternative.

items.title: Sodium Content
items.content: The tomato sauce may contain added salt; those monitoring sodium intake should check the amount.

items.title: Caloric Density
items.content: The dish is relatively calorie‑dense due to the combination of carbs, fats and protein; portion control is recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pasta hot, tossed with the sauce, poultry and vegetables. Optionally garnish with fresh basil, grated Parmesan or a pinch of black pepper.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. Do not freeze the tomato‑vegetable sauce, as the vegetable texture may change.
